title: Containers run as root, tags and Python dependencies are unpinned, no .dockerignore for etl and wavepulse

criteria.given: the etl, wavepulse and ex-accell-ui images are built
criteria.then: each Dockerfile's runtime stage declares a non-root USER before its CMD, and the Images workflow builds all three images (its build is the smoke check)

criteria.given: the etl/ and wavepulse/ build contexts are used for a docker build
criteria.then: each has a .dockerignore that excludes the local data/ directory and .env* files

criteria.given: docker-compose.yml names a third-party registry image (not a ${REGISTRY} local build ref)
criteria.then: the image is pinned by digest with an @sha256: reference

criteria.given: the ETL and WavePulse images are built
criteria.then: each copies a requirements.lock into the image and installs its requirements with that file as a pip constraints file, and both lock files are fully pinned (every package line is ==)
